text:
Diego Morales: Hi all  I opened my onboarding box and the monitor is here but there's no power brick (just the stand and cable). Dock seems fine but my Mac can't reach corp-vpn: the VPN client errors with "certificate chain not trusted". who do i file for a missing accessory and VPN cert help?
IT Helpdesk: Welcome Diego! Sorry about the missing brick. Can you share the order number from your onboarding email? for VPN can you paste the exact client error and OS version?
Diego Morales: order ONB-10022. macOS 13.6.1, client 2.4.0. error: "Handshake failed: certificate chain not trusted (code 401)"
Logistics (Jules): Thanks Diego, checking ONB-10022 now. Looks like the AC adapter was backordered and marked as "ship later" on the packing slip. I can send a replacement 65W brick and a spare HDMI cable tomorrow AM. Ticket SHIP-1199.
Diego Morales: thanks! do i need to return anything?
Logistics (Jules): No return for missing accessories. We'll include a prepaid label if an RMA ends up needed. Tracking will be posted here when it's scanned.
Network Ops: On the VPN side, 401 cert errors usually mean the device cert enrollment didn't complete. Did you click the "Enroll device" link in your welcome email?
Diego Morales: i did, but it failed with "access denied" right after SSO.
IT Helpdesk: Can you try visiting https://enroll.redwood.com/device and re-run the enrollment flow? also share the SSO username you signed in with (just the local part) so we can check flags.
Diego Morales: trying now... username diego.m. got the same Access Denied screen.
Network Ops: Thanks. I checked your account  the device_enroll flag was not set. I've flipped it; please retry in ~5min. Also if enrollment gets 403 again, open the browser dev console and copy the response body.
it-bot: Ticket created: IT-24890 (VPN cert enrollment), assigned to Network Ops.
Diego Morales: retried enrollment after 7min  flow completed! device cert installed. VPN now connects. :relieved:
Diego Morales: also FYI, the dock's ethernet port is flaky  link drops intermittently. not sure if it's the cable or dock.
IT Helpdesk: Noted. Please try another known-good ethernet cable if available. If issue persists we'll patch SHIP-1199 to include a replacement dock for swap-out.
Diego Morales: i tested another cable from my old router  same issue, link blinks then drops.
Logistics (Jules): We'll add a replacement dock to SHIP-1199 and mark it high priority. SHIP-1199 updated with UPS tracking 1ZAAA1234509876543, ETA tomorrow 10:30am.
Diego Morales: perfect, i'll confirm when everything arrives and if swapping fixes ethernet. thanks team!
IT Helpdesk: Closing loop: SHIP-1199, IT-24890 open until confirmation. If anything else pops up ping #new-hires or DM IT Helpdesk. :wave:
